name: zclass_light_set_intensity
description: zClass_Light::gwLightSetIntensity stores light intensity scale and marks light data dirty.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this light setter; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass light source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x453200 validates null-node/null-data error return 5, dirty marking, intensity-scale storage, and success return 0.
The native smoke verifies intensity storage, dirty marking, successful return, and null node/class-data error returns.
